The view shows one word at a time at a single point of focus (RSVP) on a 3D drum, with play, pause, speed (100 to 1,000 words per minute) and position controls. tools.name: eyestill_pace
tools.description: Used by the EyeStill reader view to rate how hard upcoming sentences are, so it can slow down on them.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "read_with_eyestill" is 1024 chars, far longer than this server's median (102). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
